title: Reflections on nebulae around young stars. A systematic search for late-stage infall of material onto Class II disks
question: Can the association of Class II sources with nearby reflection nebulae (RNe) be used to systematically identify disks undergoing late-stage infall of ambient cloud material?

recipe.goal: Check known Class II sources with large-scale CO structures for reflection nebulosity
recipe.method: Visual inspection and literature check of archival optical and NIR images (DSS, Pan-STARRS, HST) around five Class II sources known to have kilo-au CO structures (AB Aur, SU Aur, RU Lup, GM Aur, DO Tau)

recipe.goal: Compile and merge catalogues of reflection nebulae (RNe) in nearby star-forming regions
recipe.method: Merge published RNe catalogues from Magakian (2003) and Connelley et al. (2007), remove duplicates using a 30'' cross-matching radius, and filter for sources within circular boundaries of eight nearby star-forming regions
key_parameters: SFR circular boundaries defined by central coordinates and radii in Table 1

recipe.goal: Compile YSO catalogue and classify Class II sources via infrared spectral indices
recipe.method: Merge YSO catalogues from Marton et al. (2016) and Dunham et al. (2015) using a 5'' cross-matching radius, filter to SFR boundaries, compute infrared spectral index alpha (2-25 um) from WISE and 2MASS K-band photometry for Marton-only sources, apply median extinction correction of -0.31 to get alpha', and select Class II sources with -1.6 <= alpha' < -0.3
key_parameters: Discard sources with alpha fitting uncertainties > 0.6
assumptions: Uniform extinction correction factor of -0.31 applied to alpha for sources only in Marton et al. (2016)

recipe.goal: Cross-match Class II sources with RNe to identify late-infall candidates and compute association fractions
recipe.method: Cross-match the 2562 Class II sources with the 141 RNe in the SFRs using a projected distance threshold of ~2000 au (Bondi-Hoyle accretion scale), and evaluate cumulative association fractions as a function of offset distance
assumptions: Bondi-Hoyle length scale L_BH = 2GM_*/v^2 with M_* = 1 M_sun and v = 1 km s^-1
Median SFR distances from Zucker et al. (2020) used for physical scale conversion

recipe.goal: Query ALMA Science Archive and select adequate datasets for nearby candidate sources
recipe.method: Search ALMA Science Archive for Band 6 and Band 7 observations of the 16 candidates in SFRs at d <= 200 pc, filtering for LAS >= 1000 au, rms noise < 2.3 mJy beam^-1 (over 10 km s^-1), and coverage of 12CO lines
key_parameters: rms noise < 2.3 mJy beam^-1 over 10 km s^-1 channel width

recipe.goal: Image 12CO (2-1) ALMA data and produce moment and channel maps for S CrA and HD 97048
recipe.method: Apply standard pipeline calibration, image 12CO (2-1) emission in CASA 6.4 using Briggs weighting (robust=0.5), 0.05'' cell size, and auto-multithresh masking, then compute moment 0, moment 1, and channel maps to identify kilo-au streamers

score_reason: Catalogues and archival ALMA project codes are public and clearly identified, cross-matching radii and selection thresholds are explicitly stated, and core CASA 6.4 imaging parameters (Briggs robust=0.5, cell size 0.05'', default auto-multithresh) are given, though minor imaging/moment-map details (continuum subtraction, velocity integration windows, imsize) are omitted.
